message: Both speed up skin turnover, and together they often cause redness and peeling. Use them on alternate nights.
A retinoid plus salicylic acid in one routine is a lot of irritation at once. Alternate nights instead.
Very drying together, and benzoyl peroxide can break down some retinoids. Keep them in separate routines.
Two exfoliating acids in the same routine can over-exfoliate. Pick one per routine.
Stacking vitamin C and exfoliating acids can sting. Try vitamin C in the morning and acids at night.
Vitamin C and salicylic acid together can sting. Try vitamin C in the morning and the BHA at night.
Benzoyl peroxide can oxidise vitamin C, so neither works as well. Use them at different times of day.
Fine for many people, but the easiest setup is vitamin C in the morning and the retinoid at night.
